prompt: Overhead view of a candlelit table, a hand-drawn map now weighted open at a tunnel system, four pewter miniatures standing just inside the entrance, a fresh mug, a pencil laid across the map
motion: A hand slides the four miniatures forward together one step into the drawn tunnel. The candle steadies. Slow push in.
say: Last week they opened a door that a dwarven order sealed three hundred years ago. This week they go in. Everyone at the table already knows this is a mistake.
sfx: Quiet room, candle, a pencil set down, miniatures on paper

titles.text: EPISODE TWO - WHAT THE DARK KEPT
